candidate.title: Remove-member link wrongly shown for automatic groups due to `automatic` resolving in member item context
reports: groupmember.hbs uses {{unless automatic}} in the member context where automatic doesn't resolve, so the remove link renders for automatic groups
the group member template resolves automatic in the member context where it is absent, incorrectly showing removal links for automatic-group members
groupmember.hbs item template reaches outside its item context via implicit fallback lookup for 'automatic' and relies on fragile ember action bubbling for removemember
groupmember.hbs {{unless automatic}} resolves automatic against the member user context instead of the group, so the remove link is always shown even for automatic groups
